title: My first month without a phone
text:
Hi everyone! It's me, Kuba, again. Last month I did a crazy thing: I put my smartphone in a drawer and didn't use it for thirty days. I only had an old phone for calls and text messages.

The first week was really hard. I checked my pocket all the time, and I didn't know what to do on the bus. I felt bored and a bit lonely. My friends sent me messages on social media, and I didn't see them.

But in the second week, things changed. I started reading books again – I finished three! I also talked more with my family at dinner. I slept better, too, because I didn't look at a screen in bed.

There were some problems. I got lost in the city twice because I didn't have a map. And I missed a party because the invitation was online.

Now I use my smartphone again, but only for two hours a day. I think it's a good balance. Would you try a month without your phone? Tell me in the comments!
